# Avatar

A circle that shows a photo, or text when there is none — initials from name in Newsreader on primary-soft — in five sizes, xs to xl.

`NomNom.Avatar` · People

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.Avatar name="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.Avatar" name="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (AvatarProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `string` | Accessible name; first + last word give the initials. |
| `photo` | `string` |  |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl'` | 24 / 32 / 40 / 56 / 80 (spacing-6 / 8 / 10 / 14 / 20). @default 'md' |
| `text` | `string` | Shown instead of the initials (max two characters). |
